entries.mitigation: Focus one shade immediately to free the pinned player before the descending blade lands.
The two tethered players move apart to break the chain; if the tank is tethered, the other player should do the moving.
Control who is nearest the portal. The pulled player clears or survives the spider room while the surface group continues the fight.
Kite the tracking beam away from teammates and do not let its explosion land in the group.
Stack for deliberate corruption placement, then move together so the small arena retains usable safe space.
Use the Obsidian Husk shelter or stack for coordinated healing through the channel. Hard-mode-style play deliberately forgoes the shelter.
Block the room-wide slam and remain calm while watching for separate falling-rock markers.
Move out of falling-rock markers immediately; these are the lethal part of the Cave-In sequence.
The targeted player moves with the ring while every player avoids crossing its boundary.
Block the sequential teleport strikes as Vorenor attacks each player in turn.
Kill sacrifices to limit Vorenor's healing, or deliberately leave them alive when pursuing the associated hard-mode condition.

entries.entry_name: Fire Breath — Maw of the Infernal
entries.mitigation: Tank faces the Maw away from the group and non-tanks stay out of its frontal fire cone.

entries.entry_name: Heavy Attack — Maw of the Infernal
entries.mitigation: Block the heavy attack and avoid dragging the boss through the group.
When Imiril exits a portal, step out of or block the large spreading burst and finish any surviving adds first.
Kill Feasts before they reach Rilis and restore his health; the tank separately controls Daedroths.

entries.entry_name: Colored Bubble Curse — High Kinlord Rilis
entries.mitigation: After the bubble drops you, move to the rune matching the bubble color to remove the curse.

entries.entry_name: Hard Mode Daedroths — High Kinlord Rilis
entries.mitigation: For Cursed Hero, finish Rilis with at least three Daedroths alive while the tank controls them away from the group.
Burn the Hive Lord's temporary shield to end the room-wide Cave In sequence as quickly as possible.
Non-tanks stay clear of the boss center while the tank handles close-range pressure.
Group and kill Netchlings; their deaths strip Grobull's shield, creating the short boss-burn window.
Block or move out of Grobull's large shock field when he teleports to the current target.
Red means move through fire pressure, green means stack and heal or use levers, blue means disengage from the Guardian and kill sphere adds.
Spread several meters apart so consecutive beam splash effects do not overlap multiple players.
Kill the blue and green Hoarvors and use their matching death zones for Magicka or Stamina resource bonuses.
When the arena goes dark, immediately find and stand in the glowing white circle before the darkness damage ramps up.
Kill shadows before they fear or mind-control players into fire or off the platform.
Interrupt their heals, then focus them down before Bogdan recovers significant health.
Get clear of fire and block Bogdan's jump to survive the room reset.
Two free players activate the shrines to release the player Malubeth has lifted into the air.
Spread enough to preserve movement lanes and step out of the large persistent ground zones.
Kill the Escaped Souls immediately after the lich crystals explode so add pressure cannot accumulate.
Stack for healing when Garron teleports to the center and channels beams onto all players.

entries.entry_name: Twin Control — Varaine and Allene Pellingare
entries.mitigation: Keep both twins taunted and faced away while the group remains close enough for shared healing and add control.

entries.entry_name: Zombie Hard Mode — Varaine and Allene Pellingare
entries.mitigation: Defeat fifteen zombies during the twins encounter before finishing the bosses for the associated achievement.
